title: Wings live: De Doelen, Rotterdam | 1972
content:
Wings performed at De Doelen in Rotterdam, Netherlands, on 17 August 1972.

It was the 20th night of the Wings Over Europe Tour, which opened in Ollioules, France, on 9 July. They were Paul McCartney’s first European concerts since 1966.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Henry McCullough on guitar and vocals; and Denny Seiwell on drums.
